text:
Leah (partnerships): Heads up folks, new initiative: make a concise publisher onboarding playbook for AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace listings. Focus: minimal friction (one-page checklist), clear IAM/KMS patterns, trial provisioning behavior, and a short terraform/service-account example per cloud. Can we align on owners and timeline in this thread?

Diego (eng): I can own the AWS/GCP TF snippets + ops notes. Quick design decision: prefer publisher-owned keys/roles so they keep control. We'll provide example role/trust and a minimal policy. For networking, list PrivateLink + account-assume patterns.

Priya (legal): Agreed on publisher-owned KMS. I'll draft a short attachment for publisher agreements: CMK access for activation only, audit logs retained 90 days, and explicit trial data retention. Need to confirm trial window per cloud to include in clause.

Evan (product): Trial windows: propose AWS 14d auto-activate, GCP 14d, Azure 21d with manual opt-in for longer trials. UX question: should trial provisioning create a demo tenant automatically or send onboarding email with activation link? I prefer automated demo with clear opt-out.

Mika (solutions): I'll assemble the one-page checklist and a sample email publishers can use. Checklist items: 1) Create role/service account 2) Add Redwood principal to KMS key policy (read/Decrypt for activation) 3) Provide marketplace test ARN/ID 4) Confirm network pattern (public vs PrivateLink) 5) Share support contact. Sample AWS role name: `redwood_mp_publisher_role`. Example policy (trimmed): `{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:region:acct:key/*"}]}`

infra-bot: Vault path created: `vault:/marketplace/onboard/sampleco/staging` (secrets expire 14d).

Diego (eng): For GCP, publisher creates a service account with `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` for the redwood-runner SA and grants `kms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on the key. For Azure, create an App Registration and assign Key Vault access policy for `get`, `unwrapKey`, `wrapKey`.

Priya (legal): I'll draft the short clause and attach it to the publisher onboarding docs. Also adding a line about cross-cloud data flows if we access logs in a different region.

Leah (partnerships): Owners and timeline: Diego (TF + ops) by EOD Fri, Mika (one-pager + email templates) by Monday, Priya (legal clause) by Monday, Evan to pick pilot publisher by Wednesday. Pilot goal: verify onboarding can be completed in <3 business days.

Evan (product): I'll reach out to two potential pilot publishers and confirm. One more ask: include a short acceptance test (smoke check) that the publisher can run after setup: simple API hit that returns 200 and a KMS-wrapped token.

Mika (solutions): Noted, will include a 5-step smoke test in the checklist.

Diego (eng): I'll post TF snippets to the partnerships drive. For AWS sample: `aws_iam_role` with trust to `arn:aws:iam::REDCLOUD:role/redwood-marketplace-assume`. GCP sample: service account + IAM binding. Azure sample: role assignment snippet.

Leah (partnerships): Thanks everyone. I'll open a tracking doc and schedule a 30m sync after the artifacts land. :spiral_calendar_pad:
